$doc: Policy read by scripts/gate_a2a.py (FuzeSDLC governance/a2a-runtime-standard.md). Absence of this file makes the gate run in `fail` mode by design — this file exists to correct ONE repo-specific path, not to soften any check.

creds._sealedSecretDirs_why: The gate's own default is deploy/sealed-secrets, which does not exist in this repo. FuzeKeys' actual SealedSecret convention is deploy/argocd/sealed/ (fuzekeys-secrets.yaml, fuzekeys-tokenizer-secrets.yaml, ghcr-pull-secret.yaml, fuzefront-registration.yaml) — this entry points the gate at the real location instead of silently finding nothing there and failing every secretRef for the wrong reason.
